values.note: 2027 on the booking site: $30 a night at every campsite (2027-05-18, 07-13, 10-26); 2026: $28 (DNR rates table, booking site 2026-10-27). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Onaway State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483541: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for map '1-85', 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-10-26): all 82 campsites on fee schedule -32679, $30 for 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-10-26, $28 for 2026-10-27 + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Onaway, campground: Modern camping 20/30 AMP rate $28) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/onaway ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Onaway State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483541: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for map '1-85', 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-10-26) (all 82 campsites: 'Electrical Service=30 Amps', 'Sewer Hookup=No') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/onaway (Onaway Modern Campground tag 'Electrical service'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 82 electric campsites in a lower loop among cedars, with sites on the lake, and an upper loop in white pines (lake views from its east side), plus a camper cabin. Allowed rig lengths run 20-40 ft: 13 sites take only 20 ft, 18 take 35-40 ft. The shower building is a short walk from the lower loop.

sites.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Onaway State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483541: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for map '1-85', 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-10-26) (map '1-85': 82 campsites + 1 camper cabin; per-site allowed equipment) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/onaway (Onaway Modern Campground: 'The upper campground is nestled in towering white pines, while the lower campground is surrounded by cedar trees. The lower campground offers sites on the lake, and the east side of the upper campground provides views of the lake. Please keep in mind that the modern restrooms and showers require a short walk from the lower campground.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Two-lane sanitation station with potable water in the campground; toilet/shower building open for the whole reservation season.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/onaway (Onaway Modern Campground tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet', 'Sanitation station'; 'The park's sanitation station is in the campground. There is potable water available and two lanes.') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Onaway, campground: modern toilet/shower building 'Available for all reservable season'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Onaway, campground: reservation season starts 'May 15', ends 'October 14') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/onaway ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Onaway State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483541: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for map '1-85', 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-10-26) (82 bookable campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Modern campground on the southeast shore of Black Lake (Michigan's seventh-largest), with a cobblestone shoreline and rock outcroppings; the lower loop has sites on the lake, the upper loop sits on a bluff in white pines. Ocqueoc Falls is 10 mi east. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site + rates table: fees $28 -> $30 (2027; $28 in 2026), 30-amp (confirmed), sewer false (new), 82 sites (confirmed) to 40 ft (new), showers/flush/vault toilets, potable water and dump (new). Reservable on MiDNRReservations (confirmed); reservation season May 15 - October 14 into booking.season (new). Campground season left as derived 'seasonal' (no page states the operating dates; the note's 'mid-April to mid-November' is unsourced and was dropped). Phone 989-733-8279 matches.
